page.overview:
Who is Eldrith Jhondar?

Eldrith was plump, with a round face. Asne Zeramene claimed that drab attire suited her.

Eldrith was strong in the One Power, with a strength level of the series. Even with such strength, she was only third strongest among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, with Liandrin Guirale and Marillin Gemalphin being stronger.

Eldrith was 116 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in the series. After twelve years as a Novice and seven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 920 NE.

She was a little vague; considering her relative strength she could have risen faster as a student, but she was much too dreamy and absent-minded even then.
